resolved_conflicts.explanation: Idaho Fire Lookouts gives Warren Yahr as the 1945 staffer; its own Yahr page lists Bear Butte for 1945 to 1948 and no Seven Mile Point. The story attributes the claim to Idaho Fire Lookouts and states the conflict; it is not settled.

sources.title: Seven Mile Point Fire Lookout Tower

notes_for_editor: County 'Shoshone' matches. Elevation 4,851 ft appears on both pages but is not a schema key, so it is only in the story. Height is the stated 20-foot tower converted to metres; the sources do not say whether that is to the cab floor. 'Drive-Up' is the Idaho Fire Lookouts label; no source describes the site today or public access. The 1945 Yahr staffing is flagged because Yahr's own page does not mention this site and lists Bear Butte for 1945 to 1948. The Smokechaser catalog record is cited only for the book's date and subject.
